summary: The authorized PR-179 outputs pass the local claim-firewall checks: H_cat and q_cat are explicitly catalogue-fit coefficient labels, q_cat is withheld on the H_ONLY branch, all inspected metadata retain OBSSTAT ownership, conditional C3, standard_internal, public_use=false, transfer_source=none, and all potentially promotional phrases occur only in explicit negations or forbidden-use lists. A complete all-registered-output verdict is impossible because the manifest registers eight artifacts but the assignment authorizes inspection of only four of those artifacts. Four registered artifacts, including the mutation evidence needed to close the column-firewall claim, are outside the assignment evidence slice.

governing_contract.column_firewall_kill_switch: Any forbidden value in any numerical path requires ABSTAIN_COLUMN_FIREWALL_BREACH.
governing_contract.q_route_kill_switch: H pass with q response failure suppresses every q coefficient, amplitude, direction, envelope, and rank.
governing_contract.promotion_kill_switch: No physical, cosmological, geometry, family, transfer, native-solver, HTT evidence, posterior, PPC, or LOOCV promotion is permitted.

evidence_read.use: Repository ownership, claim-language, artifact-metadata, and shared-context authority.
Frozen coefficient naming, column firewall, C3/internal ceiling, terminal routing, required metadata, and forbidden claims.
Primary terminal claim, coefficient labels, q withholding, allowed/forbidden uses, and metadata.
Result-card wording, coefficient labels, q withholding, terminal language, and metadata.
Registered artifact inventory, artifact hashes, pack-level metadata, and source edges.
Column-firewall declarations, source/domain receipt, null-support disclosure, and metadata.
Selection/systematics sensitivity summaries, descriptive support labeling, covariance caveat, and metadata.

checks.result: The primary outputs use H_cat/q_cat names and explicitly state that they are catalogue-fit coefficient labels, not physical cosmological fields.
Both primary outputs select H_ONLY; every reported q_cat amplitude, vector, and axis is null, and q withholding is explicit.
All five inspected generated files carry OBSSTAT, conditional, C3, standard_internal, public_use=false, transfer_source=none, the same config/spec hashes, and every required metadata key.

The terminal is consistently a catalogue selection/systematics-conditional directional residual, with explicit residual-exchangeability, selection, calibration, covariance, and non-cosmological caveats.

No affirmative cosmology, isotropy, Hubble-field, acceleration, peculiar-flow, posterior, geometry, family, transfer, or native-solver promotion was found in the authorized outputs. Matches to strong terms are explicit negations, caveats, or forbidden-use entries.

The authorized raw receipt declares no Dist, P0, Cartesian, cosmology-corrected, reconstruction, or cosmological-monopole use. Enforcement and mutation closure cannot be independently verified because pr179_mutation_report.json is not authorized.

The result card includes the mandatory caveat and a bounded H-only catalogue-residual terminal. No figure or caption artifact is registered by the manifest, so a separate caption check is not applicable to this evidence slice.

The manifest registers eight artifacts. The assignment authorizes only pr179_directional_cosmography_result.json, pr179_result_card.json, pr179_raw_catalogue_receipt.json, and pr179_raw_systematics.json from that set. pr179_estimand_contract.json, pr179_mutation_report.json, pr179_null_calibration.json, and pr179_response_identifiability.json are not authorized inputs.

findings.title: The evidence slice cannot support the requested all-registered-output claim verdict
findings.expected: Every artifact registered in pr179_artifact_manifest.json is available to the blind claim reviewer so naming, metadata, forbidden promotion, q withholding, and column-firewall enforcement can be checked across the complete pack.
findings.observed: Four of eight registered artifacts are absent from required_inputs, including the mutation report that should carry executable column-firewall evidence and the null/response artifacts that may repeat numerical and claim language.
assumptions: The manifest's artifacts object is the authoritative registered-output inventory.
The mandatory shared-context rule forbids inspecting evidence not named by the assignment.
Pack-level metadata and hashes do not prove the absence of claim-language drift inside unread artifact bytes.
findings.consequence: A PASS would overstate review coverage and would not independently close the column-firewall or forbidden-promotion gates across the full pack.
findings.required_fix: Register a fresh blind complete-manifest claim assignment that includes the four omitted artifact paths and their exact hashes, then rerun the same naming, metadata, banned-language, q-withholding, column-firewall, and conditionality checks. Preserve this INCONCLUSIVE envelope as process evidence.
